record.context_brief: Asymptotic lower bound above one for discrepancy
record.original_question: With discrepancy defined by disc(A) = inf_{x in {+1,-1}^n} ||Ax||_infinity for A in {+1,-1}^{n x n}, is it true that limsup_{n->infinity} sup_{A in {+1,-1}^{n x n}} (1/sqrt(n)) * disc(A) > 1?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 12. Given the definitions above, we have lim sup_{n→∞} sup_{A∈{±1}^{n×n}} (1/√n) disc(A) > 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $n \geq 1$ and a matrix $A \in \{+1,-1\}^{n \times n}$, define the discrepancy of $A$ by
$$\mathrm{disc}(A) \;=\; \inf_{x \in \{+1,-1\}^n} \|Ax\|_\infty,$$
where $\|\cdot\|_\infty$ denotes the $\ell^\infty$ norm on $\mathbb{R}^n$. Determine whether
$$\limsup_{n \to \infty}\; \sup_{A \in \{+1,-1\}^{n \times n}} \frac{\mathrm{disc}(A)}{\sqrt{n}} \;>\; 1.$$
Equivalently, decide whether there exist a constant $c > 1$ and arbitrarily large $n$ admitting a matrix $A \in \{+1,-1\}^{n \times n}$ such that $\mathrm{disc}(A) \geq c\sqrt{n}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture in a recent open-problems compilation. Standard probabilistic and Hadamard-type constructions show $\sup_A \mathrm{disc}(A)/\sqrt{n} \geq 1$ for many $n$, but no published result establishes a strict asymptotic improvement above $1$. Related work on the Komlós conjecture provides lower bounds in the column-normalized setting (e.g. $1+\sqrt{2}$), but these do not directly resolve the $\pm 1$ matrix case at hand. No source confirming a resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: The Discrepancy of Unsatisfiable Matrices and a Lower Bound for the Komlós Conjecture Constant
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs matrices with unit-norm columns having discrepancy approaching 1+√2, giving lower bounds for the Komlós constant — a related but distinct setting.
status_evidence.claim: Related discrepancy lower-bound constructions exist, but they address the Komlós (column-normalized) setting, not the ±1 matrix discrepancy normalized by √n.

status_evidence.title: Matrix discrepancy and the log-rank conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on matrix discrepancy and Spencer-type bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent matrix-discrepancy literature does not announce a resolution of the asymptotic strict lower bound above 1 for ±1 square matrices.
